description: This file defines constants, data structures, and macros for the Simple CLI Shell component, including command tokens, help lists, argument matching, and built-in command codes.

classes.name: SCLI_SHELL_CMD_TOKEN
classes.description: Represents a token in the CLI command input, including its value and start position.

classes.name: SCLI_SHELL_CMD_TLIST
classes.description: Represents a list of command tokens, including token count, current token, and input end indicator.

classes.name: SCLI_SHELL_ARG_HELP_LIST
classes.description: Contains argument help information, including help items, count, and maximum item length.

classes.name: SCLI_CMD_ARG_MATCH_RESULT
classes.description: Stores the result of matching a command argument, including match status, positions, and error info.

classes.name: SCLI_SHELL_ARG_HELP_MATCH
classes.description: Holds matching results for argument help, including match counts and pointers to match data.

methods.name: SCLI_SHELL_FREE_ARG_HELP_LIST
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for an argument help list.

methods.name: SCLI_SHELL_FREE_ARG_HELP_MATCH
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for argument help match structure.

methods.name: SCLI_SHELL_SKIP_SPACE
methods.description: Skips whitespace characters in a command string.

methods.name: SCLI_SHELL_STRING_DIFF_AT
methods.description: Compares two strings and finds the first position where they differ, case-insensitive.
